name: timer_set
description: Set a one-shot timer or reminder. Use when the user says "set a timer for 10 minutes", "remind me in 30 minutes to call mom", "ping me in an hour". When the timer fires, PortOS raises a notification with the label. Specify the duration in minutes (or seconds for short timers).

minutes.description: Timer duration in minutes. Use this for most timers.

seconds.description: Timer duration in seconds. Use for short timers; added to minutes if both given.

label.description: What to remind the user about (e.g. "tea is ready", "call mom").
